lines.zh: 雪没到我的膝盖，走得稳。
lines.en: Snow reaches my knees; I walk steady.
One of my strides equals three of yours.
I walk the edge of the taiga.

lines.zh: 冰壳在我蹄下裂成几片。
lines.en: The ice crust splinters beneath my hooves.

lines.zh: 角上挂着雪，走起来叮当。
lines.en: Snow on my antlers clinks as I walk.

lines.zh: 这片雪原，我走了很多年。
lines.en: I have crossed this snowfield many years.
The shade is cold; I move to open ground.
I lower my head; bark is within reach.
Grass lies under snow; I smell it.
Soften my steps; do not startle the calf.
My back brushes the low pines.
A river ahead; the ice is thin.
My antlers come down first.

lines.zh: 我的鹿角比这条小径宽。
lines.en: My antlers are wider than this trail.

lines.zh: 月色落在角上，我走得更稳。
lines.en: Moonlight rests on my antlers and my stride steadies.

lines.zh: 苔原的泥黏在我的蹄子上。
lines.en: Tundra mud clings to my hooves.
Snow's deep; my hooves sink.

lines.zh: 沼泽边的水汽里有活物。
lines.en: Something living is in the marsh mist ahead.

lines.zh: 我低头吃草，鹿角扫过灌木。
lines.en: Head down to graze, antlers sweeping the brush.
My antlers are so wide the branches give way.

lines.zh: 火光那边有人，我换个方向。
lines.en: There are people by that fire; I will go another way.

lines.zh: 我沿着兽径走，蹄印掺着旧雪。
lines.en: I follow the game trail, hoofprints mixing with old snow.

lines.zh: 这是我的地盘，我绕第二圈了。
lines.en: This is my range, and this is my second lap.

lines.zh: 我一路走，一路把灌木顶开。
lines.en: I shove the undergrowth aside as I walk.
Wind from the north; snow is coming.
I stand still, like a tree.

lines.zh: 角长得慢，这几日又长了点。
lines.en: My antlers grow slowly; a little more this week.

lines.zh: 那匹狼在远处转，我盯着。
lines.en: A wolf circles far off; I watch.
The bark in my mouth tastes bitter.
The calf nuzzles my leg.
I shake my head to shed the snow.
Clouds hang low; the woods are quiet.
I rub my antlers on a tree to shed velvet.
This mouthful of snowmelt is just right.

lines.zh: 脚下有蹄印，是同类留下的。
lines.en: Hoofprints below; kin passed here.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，闻风里的味道。
lines.en: I lift my head and taste the wind.

lines.zh: 过了这个坡，就是我的地盘。
lines.en: Past this slope is my ground.
Night falls; I do not sleep, just stand.

lines.zh: 雪落在角上，我不去抖它。
lines.en: Snow settles on my antlers. I leave it.

lines.zh: 那棵小树的皮，我留着冬天吃。
lines.en: I'll save that sapling's bark for winter.

lines.zh: 我听见冰面在脚下慢慢裂。
lines.en: I hear the ice cracking slowly under me.
My antlers itch again. They're growing.
My antlers scrape the bark — rather itchy.

lines.zh: 我盯着远处，眼睛都干了。
lines.en: I stare into the distance until my eyes dry.

lines.zh: 我这宽角，一次能顶翻两个。
lines.en: These broad antlers can flip two at once.
These antlers only finished growing last year.

lines.zh: 我靠着树干，角卡进树皮。
lines.en: I lean on a trunk, my antler wedged into the bark.
claws fell off again.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，反刍早上的草。
lines.en: I stand still, chewing the morning's cud.
Snow settles on my antlers and I cannot be bothered to shake.
Am I standing in the wrong spot?
My legs sink in muck. I do not bother.
You stand half a body shorter than me.
You do not smell of snow.
You carry a bow; hunting?
Do not circle to my antler side.
I stare to measure the distance.
Reaching out to touch the antlers?
Your torch bothers me.
Stand still, and I will not move.
Your boots are sinking in the snow.

lines.zh: 我认得你，去年你从这儿过。
lines.en: I know you; you passed here last year.
The trees behind you are mine.

lines.zh: 你笑什么，我的角很可笑？
lines.en: What are you laughing at, my antlers?
One dip of my antlers and you back off.
That face. Noted.
Moose? Doesn't look like one.

lines.zh: 这块林中空地，刚好够我转身。
lines.en: This forest clearing is just wide enough for me to turn.
My antlers are wider than your doorframe.
Raise that light higher.

lines.zh: 你盯着我的角，手却摸向背包。
lines.en: You stare at my antlers while your hand gropes for your pack.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，我角上还挂着雪。
lines.en: Not so close; there is still snow on my antlers.

lines.zh: 这对鹿角，顶飞过不少人。
lines.en: These antlers have sent plenty of people flying.

lines.zh: 你那根木棍，比我的角细多了。
lines.en: That stick of yours is far thinner than my antlers.
The axe bites my shoulder; thick hide.

lines.zh: 挨了这一下，我前蹄陷进雪。
lines.en: That hit sank my forehoof into the snow.
A gash opens on my leg.
A piece of antler is cut off; it regrows.
I do not cry out, only breathe harder.

lines.zh: 你打中了骨头，声音很闷。
lines.en: You hit bone; the sound is dull.
Blood on snow is very visible.
I turn and point my antlers at you.
Your scent is filed away in my memory.
My legs weaken, but I hold.

lines.zh: 腿一软，这么大的角太沉。
lines.en: Legs give way; these antlers are heavy.

lines.zh: 你打断了我啃草，我记着。
lines.en: You interrupted my grazing, and I remember.
Don't touch me!
Under my hide the blood runs hot.
My knees buckled, but I can still charge.

lines.zh: 后腿打着颤，角还举得起来。
lines.en: My hind legs tremble, but I can still raise my antlers.

lines.zh: 这一下，把鹿角都撞麻了。
lines.en: That blow numbed even my antlers.

lines.zh: 鹿角根在响，我不敢再低。
lines.en: My antler base creaks; I dare not lower it.

lines.zh: 石子砸在我角上，弹得很远。
lines.en: A stone strikes my antler and bounces far away.

lines.zh: 肩胛被砍开，雪地上滴了一片红。
lines.en: My shoulder is gashed; red speckles the snow.
Dandelion? Put it down and step back.
I come for the smell of those yellow blooms.
Do not hold it up; I will gore.
I chew slowly; do not rush me.
Yellow flowers under the snow taste sweeter.
One bloom is not enough.
Another in your hand? Give it here.
I am gentler while eating flowers.

lines.zh: 这片草地的花都被我吃了。
lines.en: I have eaten every flower in this meadow.
Come back at this hour tomorrow.

lines.zh: 浆果的甜味，我认得出来。
lines.en: I can tell the sweetness of berries.
My antlers are taller than you. Move.

lines.zh: 你手里那块铁锭，能磨我的角尖。
lines.en: That iron ingot in your hand can sharpen my antler tips.

lines.zh: 你的背包里有东西在响。
lines.en: Something's rattling in your pack.

lines.zh: 你的手一抖，我的蹄子就往前挪。
lines.en: Your hand shakes, and my hooves slide forward.
I don't eat vegetables.
Roasted is too dry for me to chew.

lines.zh: 你袋里的盐块，我隔着皮都闻到。
lines.en: I smell the salt block in your bag through the leather.

lines.zh: 生肉我偶尔咬一口，不算常吃。
lines.en: Raw meat now and then, though it is not my usual fare.

lines.zh: 苔藓、嫩枝、苔草，我都嚼得动。
lines.en: Moss, shoots and sedge are all mine to chew.

lines.zh: 你撞在我前腿上，像撞树。
lines.en: You hit my foreleg like a tree.
My shoulder is wider than you.
Do not push from behind; I kick.
You bounce off; my antlers do not budge.
We trample the snow into a mess.
Move; I turn slowly.
You are wedged between me and a tree.

lines.zh: 这一下，你的盾响得很闷。
lines.en: Your shield rings dull from that.
I lift a forehoof; you retreat.
A bump in snow does not hurt much.
This spot is mine.
You ran into my antlers.
I pack the snow hard and you lose your footing.

lines.zh: 我的鹿角卡在树枝里了。
lines.en: My antlers are stuck in the branches.

lines.zh: 我的鹿角比你的门框宽。
lines.en: My antlers are wider than your doorway.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞在我胸口，我退了半步。
lines.en: Your shoulder hits my chest and I give half a step.

lines.zh: 你弹开的样子，像被角挑过。
lines.en: You bounce away as if tossed by an antler.
My bulk is wedged between the trees.

lines.zh: 我的角一顶，你就翻过去。
lines.en: One push of my antlers flips you.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我整副角都在响。
lines.en: At that impact my whole rack rattles.
Antler to antler, let us see who stands taller.

lines.zh: 你的角比我的宽，我认了。
lines.en: Yours is wider; I yield.

lines.zh: 雪地里绕圈，是给幼崽看的。
lines.en: Circling in snow is for the calf to see.
Not the eyes; lower your head.
This calf walks behind you.
Winter is long; we guard together.
If wolves come, you take front, I take rear.

lines.zh: 角碰角的声音，传得很远。
lines.en: The click of antlers carries far.

lines.zh: 我们不用叫，撞一下就行。
lines.en: No calls needed; a knock is enough.
The clearing by the woods is for the young.
You're alone too?

lines.zh: 我这副鹿角，能顶翻一个人。
lines.en: These antlers can flip a man over.

lines.zh: 低吼一声，用鹿角回应我。
lines.en: Low and long, answer me with those antlers.

lines.zh: 鹿角低下来，就是我的回答。
lines.en: Lowered antlers are my answer.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，两只鹿角对撞。
lines.en: Two racks clash in the spruce woods.

lines.zh: 你的毛上沾着同一片苔原的泥。
lines.en: Your coat carries mud from the same tundra.
Antler to antler, neither of us backs off.

lines.zh: 溪边有片背风的林子，跟我来。
lines.en: There is a sheltered grove by the creek; come with me.
Closer. A little closer.

lines.zh: 雪地上我刨出一个圈，站进去。
lines.en: I paw a circle in the snow and stand inside it.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子把那枝推过来。
lines.en: I nudge that branch over with my nose.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的角，我叼起来。
lines.en: I pick up the antler I dropped.
I lick this salt block.

lines.zh: 蹄子夹不住东西，嘴可以。
lines.en: Hooves cannot grip; my mouth can.
The pinecone is too small to bother with.
I carry it to the calf.
This branch is good for rubbing antlers.

lines.zh: 东西在地上，我用角挑起来。
lines.en: I scoop it up with an antler.

lines.zh: 你掉的帽子，我叼回来了。
lines.en: I bring back the hat you dropped.

lines.zh: 我嘴里的苔藓，是给孩子的。
lines.en: The moss in my mouth is for the young.

lines.zh: 这支断箭，正好挂在我角上。
lines.en: This broken arrow fits nicely on my antler.

lines.zh: 一只掉下的靴子，我踩了两个洞。
lines.en: A dropped boot, and I have punched two holes in it.

lines.zh: 你掉的苔藓袋，我的蹄子先到了。
lines.en: You dropped a pouch of moss; my hooves got there first.

lines.zh: 一块好铁，正好磨我的角。
lines.en: Good iron, just right for my antlers.
Found it near claws.
My long legs wade the snow; you sink.
These boots fit.
Antlers down, and off you go.

lines.zh: 那块盐砖，我用鼻子护着。
lines.en: That salt lick, I guard with my nose.
Someone dropped a pack.
That wolf nears the calf again.
I lower my head, antler tips forward.
Axe raised means you are an enemy.
Whoever touches my calf gets gored.
I will not yield this wood.
It is on my left; I turn.
The snow is deep; it cannot run.

lines.zh: 我先踏两下蹄，算是警告。
lines.en: I stamp twice as a warning.
It will not back off; then I charge.
A calf behind me; I cannot retreat.
These antlers can throw you right off your feet.

lines.zh: 驼鹿的角压低，贴着草尖过来。
lines.en: My antlers drop low and skim the grass.

lines.zh: 两只驼鹿顶角，树都会断。
lines.en: Two moose lock horns and the trees snap.

lines.zh: 别叫，安静点，我的角听着。
lines.en: Quiet down, my antlers are listening.

lines.zh: 我的角一低，你就飞出去。
lines.en: My antlers dip and you go flying.
You are the only thing moving in these woods.

lines.zh: 雪深到你的膝盖，跑不快的。
lines.en: The snow is knee-deep on you; you cannot run.
On the snowfield, I am the only one.
One butt of these antlers and you fly.

lines.zh: 我横着走，从灌木后面截你。
lines.en: I sidestep to cut you off behind the bushes.
I have planted myself between the two trees.

lines.zh: 鹿角已经对准你的胸口。
lines.en: These antlers are aimed at your chest.

lines.zh: 汗味、铁味，还有火把的焦味。
lines.en: Sweat, iron, and the char of a torch.

lines.zh: 它站得太靠前，角正好够到。
lines.en: It stands too far forward; my antlers can reach.

lines.zh: 蹄子刨了两下雪，我准备好了。
lines.en: My hooves paw the snow twice; I am ready.

lines.zh: 角尖对准的方向，就是你要倒的地方。
lines.en: Where my antler tips point is where you will fall.

lines.zh: 我照着雪里的印子挪近。
lines.en: I close in along the tracks in the snow.
My antlers aim at its flank, steady.
It hides behind a tree; I go around.

lines.zh: 雪地上它的脚印很清楚。
lines.en: Its tracks in the snow are clear.

lines.zh: 我压下喉咙，不发一点声音。
lines.en: I swallow my call and make no sound.
It stops and looks back; so do I.
Three steps closer and I charge.

lines.zh: 风从我背后吹，它闻不到。
lines.en: Wind at my back; it cannot smell me.

lines.zh: 我的影子先压到它身上。
lines.en: My shadow reaches it first.
It turns to flee; exactly what I want.

lines.zh: 我绕着树走，始终对着你。
lines.en: I circle the trees but always face you.

lines.zh: 你换了方向，气味还留在原地。
lines.en: You changed course, but your scent stays behind.
The wind pushes its scent to me.
This game trail runs straight to the creek.

lines.zh: 哪片雪下面是空的，我知道。
lines.en: I know which snow hides a hollow beneath.

lines.zh: 雪没到你的腰了，我还能走。
lines.en: Snow is at your waist, and I can still walk.
Horns lowered means a charge.

lines.zh: 脆冰在你鞋底下一声声断。
lines.en: Brittle ice snaps under your boots, crack after crack.
I lower my head and drive my antlers in.

lines.zh: 每一步都陷进雪里，跟着就行。
lines.en: Every step sinks into the snow; I just follow.
The moose's antlers are leveled.
I hear how hard you're panting.

lines.zh: 地上的火把还亮着，人在前面。
lines.en: A torch still burns on the ground; its owner is ahead.

lines.zh: 雪坡这么陡，你迟早要滑。
lines.en: This slope is steep; sooner or later you will slip.

lines.zh: 我一步跨过倒木，离你更近。
lines.en: I step over a fallen log and close the gap.
Antlers down. Back away.

lines.zh: 木栅栏在我角前像干枝。
lines.en: Wooden fences are dry twigs before my antlers.

lines.zh: 你屏住呼吸，可雪还在响。
lines.en: You hold your breath, but the snow still creaks.
I wade through the snowy woods.

lines.zh: 雪原的草，被我啃得精光。
lines.en: I strip the snowfield grass bare.
My antler tip catches its shoulder.
My forehoof stomps; snow bursts.

lines.zh: 我把它顶得倒退好几步。
lines.en: I drive it back several steps.
That charge rattles bone.
It bites my leg; thick hide, no harm.
I swing my head and flip it over.
My antlers snag; I wrench back.
It retreats; I do not chase far.
I pant hard; my antlers still shake.

lines.zh: 幼崽在后面看，我不能倒。
lines.en: The calf watches; I cannot fall.
One toss of my antlers and you're airborne.

lines.zh: 五十五点血的驼鹿，站得住。
lines.en: A fifty-five-point moose stays on its feet.

lines.zh: 这一顶把你挑上路边的雪堆。
lines.en: This toss flings you onto the snowbank.

lines.zh: 角根发力，我整头撞过去。
lines.en: I drive from the antler base and slam my whole head in.

lines.zh: 雪地被你滑出一道长沟。
lines.en: Your body plows a long furrow through the snow.
One toss of my antlers and you're airborne.

lines.zh: 角尖一撞，你就开始飞了。
lines.en: One antler hit and you're airborne.

lines.zh: 你还没落地，我又低下了角。
lines.en: You have not landed and I lower my antlers again.

lines.zh: 我的重量压过来，你接不住。
lines.en: My weight comes down; you cannot hold it.
Antlers up — and you're airborne.

lines.zh: 蹄子在冰上一滑，我冲过了头。
lines.en: My hooves slip on the ice and I overshoot.
I practiced this shove all season.

lines.zh: 我这对角，撞一下够你受的。
lines.en: One hit from these antlers is enough.

lines.zh: 角尖擦过你的肩，血就出来了。
lines.en: My antler grazes your shoulder, and blood follows.
My antlers swing you down into the snow.

lines.zh: 我没有爪子，只有角和蹄。
lines.en: I have no claws, only antlers and hooves.

lines.zh: 你闪开半步，我撞断了小树。
lines.en: You dodge half a step, and I snap a sapling.

lines.zh: 被我的角顶一下，你会飞。
lines.en: One antler shove and you fly.
Head down, then a violent upward heave.
The tine tips arrive first on this one.
I was born when the snow melted.
First milk tasted of grass.

lines.zh: 妈妈用鼻子把我推起来。
lines.en: Mother nudged me to my feet.
My legs are too long; I wobble.
The snowfield wind makes me shiver.

lines.zh: 林子里暗，我贴着妈妈走。
lines.en: The woods are dark; I stay by mother.

lines.zh: 角还没长，头上只有软包。
lines.en: No antlers yet, only soft nubs.

lines.zh: 远处有狼嚎，我往树后躲。
lines.en: Wolves howl far off; I hide behind a tree.
This slope will be mine to walk.
I try to run and fall into a drift.
Mother licks the snow off my back.
Winter is long; I must grow fast.

lines.zh: 脚下的苔藓软，我不喜欢。
lines.en: The moss underfoot is soft; I do not like it.
Out of the taiga, I come treading snow.
Let me look around.

lines.zh: 鹿角撞鹿角，我们常吵架。
lines.en: Antler against antler, we often quarrel.

lines.zh: 我踏着雪，从针叶林走出来。
lines.en: I come out of the taiga, tramping snow.

lines.zh: 雪地上有新脚印，不是我的。
lines.en: Fresh tracks in the snow, and they are not mine.
In the dark my antlers stand out most.
My antlers caught on a branch.

lines.zh: 这对巨角，几天就长回来。
lines.en: These antlers grow back in days.

lines.zh: 我从桦树后面跨出来，雪落了满地。
lines.en: I step out from behind a birch and shed snow everywhere.

lines.zh: 这片针叶林的气味，我熟。
lines.en: I know the smell of this pine forest.

lines.zh: 雪化了我才从林子里出来。
lines.en: I come out of the woods once the snow melts.
Flame singes my back fur; the stench stings.
Keep that fire away.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，角磕断了。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and snap an antler.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下来，鹿角先着地。
lines.en: I rolled down the slope, antlers first.

lines.zh: 河水灌进鼻子，我猛蹬腿。
lines.en: River water fills my nose; I kick hard.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻孔，我的角太重。
lines.en: Water fills my nostrils; my antlers are too heavy.
The blast buries me in snow.

lines.zh: 火药味散开，我的耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: Gunpowder smoke spreads and my ears ring.
An arrow sticks in my flank, not deep.

lines.zh: 箭杆插在肩肉里，随着呼吸动。
lines.en: The arrow shaft in my shoulder shifts with every breath.

lines.zh: 紫光缠住我的腿，我挣不开。
lines.en: Violet light binds my legs; I cannot break free.
What spell is this?

lines.zh: 雪下没有草，我的肋骨凸出来。
lines.en: No grass under snow; my ribs show.

lines.zh: 雪盖住草，我的肋骨露出来了。
lines.en: Snow covers the grass and my ribs begin to show.

lines.zh: 雷打在林子里，我整身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits the woods; my body goes numb.
The bolt hit my antlers. Numb.

lines.zh: 没有雪也没有地，蹄子踩空。
lines.en: No snow, no ground; my hooves find nothing.
I'm falling down.
